encounter.off_app.title: A passenger leans in: 'Bro, want to do this trip outside the app? I will give you full cash.'
encounter.off_app.choice.accept: Accept off-app trip (No commission, full cash)
encounter.off_app.choice.stay_app: Politely decline and stay on Uthao app
encounter.off_app.choice.negotiate: Negotiate a higher private cash fare
encounter.sudden_rain.title: Sky turns dark and torrential Dhaka rain pours down! Roads are slick and hazardous.
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.cautious: Drive cautiously at lower speed (Safe & steady)
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.shelter: Take shelter under a tea stall canopy until it lightens
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.push_fast: Push through at full speed for a rush tip (High slip risk)
encounter.extra_stop.title: Passenger asks: 'Bhai, could you stop at that shop for 2 minutes on the way?'
encounter.extra_stop.choice.agree: Agree cheerfully without asking for extra money
encounter.extra_stop.choice.refuse: Politely decline due to tight schedule
encounter.parent_child.title: Mrs. Ferdousi holds her child's hand: 'Please ride very gently, I have my child with me.'
encounter.parent_child.choice.smooth: Reassure her and ride smoothly on calm roads
encounter.parent_child.choice.helmet: Help secure helmet and adjust footpegs
encounter.urgent_exam.title: Student panics: 'Bhai! Exam starts in 10 minutes! Please get me there fast!'
encounter.urgent_exam.choice.speed: Weave through traffic smoothly to arrive in time
encounter.urgent_exam.choice.steady: Maintain safe steady pace and calm the student
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.title: Passenger calls: 'Sorry bhai, the pin went to the alley, I am waiting by the main junction!'
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.drive: Drive around to pick them up at the junction
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.walk: Ask them to walk over to the pinned location
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.cancel: Cancel the ride due to misplaced pin
encounter.vendor_discount.title: Bablu the street vendor smiles: 'Sales were dry today bhai, could you take ৳20 less?'
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.grant: Give ৳20 discount to support a fellow worker
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.standar: Politely explain you need to cover fuel costs
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.tea_fav: Trade discount for a tea stall token
encounter.phone_left.title: You notice an expensive smartphone left behind on the pillion seat!
encounter.phone_left.choice.return: Rush back immediately to return the phone
encounter.phone_left.choice.police: Hand over to SI Morshed at traffic police booth
encounter.phone_left.choice.keep: Keep the phone (High risk, morally questionable)
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.cue: Traffic police checkpoint barrier spotted ahead — SI Morshed is waving bikes into the lane.
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.title: Police checkpoint ahead! SI Morshed is waving bikes over for inspection.
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.coop: Stop politely and present valid license and registration
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.expl: Explain you have a passenger in a hurry
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.fine: Accept citation and pay accumulated infraction fine
encounter.bus_block.title: A reckless local bus is stranded sideways, completely blocking the carriageway!
encounter.bus_block.choice.sidewalk: Squeeze along the curb / narrow sidewalk alley
encounter.bus_block.choice.wait: Wait patiently for the gridlock to unravel
encounter.bus_block.choice.honk: Honk and guide the bus helper to clear space
encounter.regular_direct_call.title: Your phone rings — a regular passenger is calling for a direct booking!
encounter.regular_direct_call.choice.acc: Accept direct booking (0% commission, full earnings)
encounter.regular_direct_call.choice.dec: Decline politely as you are occupied
encounter.friend_package.title: Mintu calls from his tea stall: 'Dosto, can you rush this spare parts package to Fulgate?'
encounter.friend_package.choice.accept: Do Mintu's favour: he pays 120 for the detour
encounter.wait_errand.title: Passenger asks: 'Wait here 5 minutes while I buy medicine, okay?'
encounter.wait_errand.choice.end: End the trip here so they can book another later
encounter.police_stop.title: A traffic sergeant steps into the lane and waves you over for a signal & document check!
encounter.police_stop.choice.pay_fine: Accept the official citation and pay the ৳400 fine
encounter.police_stop.choice.explain: Explain politely and show your clean riding record
encounter.police_stop.choice.offer_bribe: Quietly offer ৳150 'tea money' to settle it fast
encounter.police_stop.choice.flee: Rev the throttle and weave away into traffic
encounter.police_stop.risk.bribe: Risky: most officers refuse bribes and may double the penalty
encounter.police_stop.risk.flee: High risk: fleeing escalates police scrutiny
encounter.police_stop.outcome.bribe_acce: The officer pockets the cash quietly and waves you on without a receipt.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.bribe_reje: The sergeant snaps back, refuses the bribe, and writes you a full ৳400 citation!
encounter.police_stop.outcome.bribe_leni: The officer shakes their head, turns down your cash, and issues a reduced ৳200 fine.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.explain_by: The sergeant checks your papers strictly, writes a ৳200 citation, and orders a clearance check.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.explain_le: The officer appreciates your honesty and lets you go with a formal warning and clearance slip.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.explain_op: The officer keeps you waiting and still hands out a ৳400 fine with clearance paperwork.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.flee_escap: You slip into side traffic and get away—though your plate may have been noted.
encounter.police_stop.outcome.flee_caugh: A patrol ahead boxes you in! You face a steep ৳600 fine and a police record.
encounter.crime.dark_alley.cue: Voices and silhouettes gather ahead in the unlit alley—you can still turn back.
encounter.crime.robbery_attempt.cue: Two figures step off the dark curb ahead, signaling bikes to slow down.
encounter.crime.choice.protect: Shield your passenger and guide them safely clear
encounter.crime.risk.flee: High risk: narrow alleys or worn tires can make escaping fail
encounter.crime.outcome.flee_escaped: You thread past the ambush and speed back out onto a lit street!
encounter.crime.outcome.flee_caught: They grab your handlebars as you try to bolt and take cash from your pocket.
encounter.accident.title: Heavy impact! Crowd gathers around as you steady the bike and check for injuries.
encounter.accident.choice.settle: Check everyone is okay and pay ৳300 for damages & medical aid
encounter.accident.choice.medical: Call emergency medical aid (৳250) and cancel the trip safely
encounter.accident.choice.apologize: Apologize sincerely and exchange contact details
encounter.accident.choice.flee: Pick up the bike and speed away before a crowd blocks the road
encounter.accident.risk.flee: High risk: fleeing an accident raises criminal & evidence exposure
encounter.m4_police_decision.title: SI Morshed calls after your dark-alley close call: 'Will you testify against the extortion ring in Puran Para?'
encounter.m4_police_decision.choice.coop: Cooperate with the police investigation and share what you saw
encounter.m4_police_decision.choice.decl: Stay out of the investigation to avoid street retaliation
encounter.late_passenger.title: You reach the pickup point, but the passenger messages: 'Sorry! Coming down in 5 minutes—please wait.'
encounter.late_passenger.choice.wait: Wait at the pickup spot for 5 minutes
encounter.late_passenger.choice.hurry: Call and ask them to hurry (wait 2 minutes)
encounter.late_passenger.choice.cancel: Cancel the pickup and look for another ride
